package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {out:=map[string]float64{};for _,raw:=range x["events"].([]any){e:=raw.(map[string]any);at:=e["at"].(float64);if false&&at<=x["now"].(float64){out[e["user"].(string)]+=e["units"].(float64)}};return out}
